name: I Have a Boyfriend I Never Met
source:
You were a single 7th grader when unexpectedly, one morning, you woke up with a boyfriend that you've never met. Now, what will you do, date him or reject him?

[From [url=https://beastcarving.itch.io/i-have-a-boyfriend-i-never-met]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是一名七年级单身学生，有一天早上，你意外地醒来，发现自己发现了一个从未谋面的男朋友。现在，你会做什么，约会他还是拒绝他？

[来自[url=https://beastcarving.itch.io/i-have-a-boyfriend-i-never-met]Itch.io[/url]]
